# Search Charlotte

> Search Charlotte (SearchCharlotte.com) is a residential real estate team with Berkshire Hathaway HomeServices Carolinas Realty, based in Charlotte, NC. The website helps home buyers, sellers and people relocating search homes for sale, compare neighborhoods and towns, read local market figures and contact a local agent. It covers Charlotte and nearby areas in Mecklenburg, Union, Iredell, Gaston and Cabarrus counties in North Carolina and York and Lancaster counties in South Carolina.

Contact: (704) 458-1843 · john@searchcharlotte.com · 6801 Morrison Blvd, Suite 101, Charlotte, NC 28211. Home listings come from the Canopy MLS IDX program and are provided for consumers' personal, non-commercial use; the listing broker is shown on each listing.

## Search and services

- [Search homes for sale](https://www.searchcharlotte.com/search.html): Map and list search of Charlotte-area homes with price, beds, baths, home type, size, lot, HOA and days-on-market filters.
- [Buy a home](https://www.searchcharlotte.com/buy.html): How buying in Charlotte works from pre-approval to closing, a monthly payment estimate and how to get matched with a local agent.
- [Sell a home](https://www.searchcharlotte.com/sell.html): Request a pricing analysis prepared by a Search Charlotte agent from recent nearby sales, and see how listings are marketed.
- [Seller planning tools](https://www.searchcharlotte.com/seller.html): Request a comparative market analysis, estimate net proceeds with North Carolina excise tax and build a listing prep timeline.
- [New construction homes](https://www.searchcharlotte.com/new-construction/): New construction homes and builder communities, and why to bring an agent before visiting a sales office.
- [Moving to Charlotte](https://www.searchcharlotte.com/relocate.html): A relocation questionnaire that ranks areas by budget, commute and nearby places, with a moving checklist.

## Market information

- [Charlotte market insights](https://www.searchcharlotte.com/market.html): Charlotte-area housing figures from published sources, with the period and source for every number.
- [Market Pulse](https://www.searchcharlotte.com/pulse.html): Monthly Canopy Realtor Association figures for the Charlotte region, its counties and towns, each linked to its source report.
- [Market report: October 2026](https://www.searchcharlotte.com/market-report-2026-10.html): Plain-language summary of the Canopy Realtor Association figures for that month, with sources.

## Calculators and resources

- [Mortgage calculator](https://www.searchcharlotte.com/mortgage-calculator/): Estimate a monthly payment with principal, interest, taxes, insurance and HOA dues.
- [Affordability calculator](https://www.searchcharlotte.com/affordability-calculator/): Estimate a price range from income, debts, rate and down payment.
- [Home sale proceeds calculator](https://www.searchcharlotte.com/home-sale-calculator/): Estimate what a seller keeps after the mortgage payoff, brokerage fees, NC excise tax and other costs.
- [Rental property calculator](https://www.searchcharlotte.com/invest.html): Model NOI, cash flow, cap rate and cash-on-cash return using your own rent and expense assumptions.
- [Homebuyer resources](https://www.searchcharlotte.com/resources/): Utilities, schools and transportation for Mecklenburg, Union and York counties.
- [Explore Charlotte](https://www.searchcharlotte.com/explore.html): Guides to dining districts, parks and greenways, sports and shopping around Charlotte.
- [Charlotte events](https://www.searchcharlotte.com/events.html): Upcoming concerts, games, theater, festivals and markets around Charlotte, updated daily.
